THE FAR EASTERN TIMES,
OCTOBER 6, 1923

SUN YAT-SEN'S REPLY
TO MR. KARAKHAN

Thinks Northern Govt.
Greatest Obstacle To
Good Relations

(Rosta)
Peking, Oct. 5.—Mr. L. M.
Karakhan, Extraordinary Plenipoten-
tiary Envoy of the Union of Soviet
Socialist Republics, after his arrival
here, sent a telegram to Dr. Sun Yat-
sen in Canton, greeting him as an old
friend of Soviet Russia and asking him
"for aid in the great task of bringing
the Chinese and Russian peoples into
the closest relations, which is the best
pledge of their free and peaceful
development." Dr. Sun Yat-sen has
sent a telegram in reply, the text of
which follows:
"I am deeply moved by your gen-
erous appreciation of my friendship
for New Russia; and I affirm that no
criticism of the order of ideas, for
which you stand, can or will prevent
me from holding with you that the
real interests of our respective coun-
tries demand the formulation of a
common policy which will enable us
to live on terms of equality with other
Powers and free from the political and
economic servitude imposed under an
international system resting on force
and working through the methods
of economic imperialism. You are
right to be reassured at the manifest-
ations of sympathy and welcome
which have greeted your arrival in
China."

The Peking Government
My fellow countrymen, I am pers-
uaded, sincerely wish for the success
of your mission, particularly in the

《远东时报》，
1923年10月6日

孙中山先生
致加拉罕先生的复函

认为北方政府是
良好关系的最大障碍

（罗斯塔通讯社）
北京，10月5日电。苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟特命全权代表L. M. 加拉罕先生抵达此处后，向广州的孙中山博士发送电报，称其为苏俄的老朋友，并请他“在使中俄两国人民建立最密切关系这一伟大任务中提供援助，这是两国自由与和平发展的最佳保证。”孙中山博士已去电回复，全文如下：
“阁下对新俄罗斯之友谊给予慷慨赞誉，令余深感欣慰；余谨声明，任何针对阁下所秉持之思想体系的批评，均不能亦不会阻止余与阁下持有如下观点：即我们各自国家的真正利益要求制定一项共同政策，使我们能够以平等地位与其他列强相处，并摆脱建立在武力之上、通过经济帝国主义手段运作的国际体系所强加的政治与经济奴役。阁下因在华受到同情与欢迎的表现而感到宽慰，此举是正确的。”

北京政府
余深信，我的同胞们真诚地希望阁下的使命取得成功，特别是在

matter of the formal recognition of
the Soviet Government. But your
most formidable difficulty lies in
negotiating with a political group
which, besides being wholly unrepre-
sentative of the Chinese people, has
ceased to bear even the appearance of
a national government, and whose di-
plomacy is in reality guided more by
the wishes and desires of certain for-
eign Powers than by the vital interests
of China as an independent and
sovereign State.
“You have already had striking ex-
ample of this Chinese subservience to
alien interests at the reception given in
your honour by the Peking delegate
who has been appointed to negotiate
with you. He invited you to model
the Soviet policy on that of America;
and you properly rebuked him by de-
claring that Russia will never follow
the example of America nor put her
signature to such a document as the
Lincheng note. Russia will never claim
rights of extraterritoriality and
capitulations nor establish courts
of administration in Chinese territory.
Russia repudiates any and every
concession and privilege that violates
the sovereignty or interest of the
Chinese people. Russia has established
in her relations with China the
principle of complete and absolute
equality. In the name of the Chinese
people, I have to applaud and thank
you for having read this memorable
lesson in political realism to that apt
servant of the present masters of
Peking.”

正式承认苏维埃政府一事上。但阁下所面临的最严峻困难，在于与一个政治集团进行谈判，该集团不仅完全不能代表中国人民，甚至已不再具备国家政府的外表，其外交行动实际上更多受某些外国列强的意愿和欲望所指引，而非基于中国作为一个独立主权国家的切身利益。
“在获任命与阁下谈判的北京代表为欢迎阁下而举行的招待会上，阁下已目睹这种中国人屈从于外人利益的显著例证。他邀请阁下以美国的政策为蓝本制定苏维埃政策；而阁下予以恰当驳斥，宣称俄罗斯绝不会效仿美国，也不会签署诸如《临城照会》之类的文件。俄罗斯绝不会主张治外法权和领事裁判权，也不会在华领土设立行政法庭。俄罗斯摒弃任何侵犯中国人民主权或利益的租界与特权。俄罗斯在与中国的关系中确立了完全且绝对平等的原则。余谨代表中国人民，对阁下向当前北京主子的得力仆从讲授这一难忘的政治现实主义课程，表示赞赏与感谢。”
